Check language versions and runtime By ET Entertainment Desk , ET Online Last Updated: Nov 11, 2026, 09:23:00 AM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis Rajinikanth’s Jailer 2 is set to stream on OTT from November 12, 2026. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, the film has a runtime of 2 hours and 43 minutes. It earned Rs 827 crore worldwide, becoming one of the biggest Tamil hits of the year. The film also stars Mohanlal, Shiva Rajkumar, Ramya Krishnan and Vidya Balan.
 Jailer 2 is currently streaming on OTT (Credit: Instagram) Superstar Rajinikanth 's latest film, Jailer 2 , is gearing for OTT release after a successful run at the domestic and international box office. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, the action sequel crossed the Rs 800 crore mark worldwide and set several box office records since its theatrical release. The film is all set to make digital debut, giving fans another chance to watch Rajinikanth's action-packed performance from home.
 Jailer 2 OTT release: When and where to watch
Jailer 2 will stream on Amazon Prime Video from November 12, 2026. The film is all set to arrive on the platform following its successful theatrical run, during which it emerged as one of the biggest Tamil releases of the year.
The sequel has a runtime of 2 hours and 43 minutes on the streaming platform. Several fans had expected the OTT version to include deleted scenes or an extended cut of the film. However, the listed runtime suggests that the digital release does not feature any additional footage. 
Those hoping to watch the deleted scenes will have to wait for the makers to share an update on whether they plan to release them separately.

 Jailer 2 box office collection
Jailer 2 enjoyed a strong run in theatres, collecting Rs 551.15 crore gross in India, while its domestic net collection stood at Rs 471.25 crore in 26 days, according to Sacnilk.
 The film also made a mark in Tamil Nadu. It collected Rs 217.75 crore gross in the state, surpassing Vijay's The GOAT, which had a lifetime collection of Rs 217.25 crore. Vijay's Leo occupies the third position with Rs 215.31 crore.
 Moreover, more than 60 per cent of Jailer 2's domestic gross earnings came from markets outside Tamil Nadu. The film also reportedly earned over Rs 75 crore in each of the four southern markets.
Its worldwide gross collection reached Rs 827 crore, with more than 3.2 crore tickets sold during its theatrical run.

 Jailer 2: Cast and crew
Produced by Sun Pictures, Jailer 2 features Rajinikanth in the lead role. The film also stars Ramya Krishnan, Mohanlal, Shiva Rajkumar, Mirnaa, Vidya Balan, Mithun Chakraborty, S.J. Suryah, Suraj Venjaramoodu and Jatin Sarna in important roles.
Mohanlal and Shiva Rajkumar return to reprise their roles from the first instalment. Anirudh Ravichander has composed the music for the film, while Nelson Dilipkumar has directed the sequel.
With its theatrical run making way for newer releases, Jailer 2 is now set to reach audiences who missed watching it on the big screen. Its OTT debut also allows fans to revisit the film and its ensemble cast.
